name: angular
description: Angular front-end pack: Angular implementation rules, a UI Bindings table (element to operation to state) checked against the contract, mock-ups and templates, a change impact map, the build-lint-unit loop, human-written acceptance cases (converted from Excel, CSV or Markdown) as the final gate, advisory gate sensors, and the local Angular CLI MCP server.

angular-mcp.description: Add the Angular CLI MCP server (local, read-only, offline) to this project's MCP settings

angular-cases.description: Convert acceptance cases (.xlsx, .csv or a Markdown table) to angular-acceptance-cases.json

angular-bindings-check.description: Check a UI Bindings table against the contract and the mock-ups, and print its matrix
